description: Audio-conditioned lip synchronization of a reference video.

request.name: reference_video_path
request.description: Reference video containing the face to synchronize. Requires FFmpeg on PATH.

request.name: cache_interval
request.description: DeepCache refresh interval. One disables caching; three matches the upstream DeepCache preset. Higher values trade output fidelity for speed.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Audio classifier-free guidance scale; values at or below one disable CFG.

request.name: frames_per_chunk
request.description: Frames processed together by the temporal denoiser.

request.name: fps
request.description: Video sampling and output frame rate.

request.name: seed
request.description: Random seed for latent noise and VAE posterior sampling.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Weight storage type; native preserves packaged tensor types.

session.name: vae_cudnn_f16
session.description: Use cuDNN FP16 VAE execution on CUDA. Requires a build with GGML_CUDA_CUDNN_CONV2D=ON; VAE weights are converted to FP16.
